In addition to internal reuse within the *Milindapañha*, DharmaNexus documents text reuse with canonical Sutta Piṭaka texts, aligning passages with the *Nandakovāda Sutta* (MN 146), the *Laṭukikopama Sutta* (MN 66), and the *Chakkanipāta* of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 6) [DharmaNexus].
